risks.proof: A close-up shot of the table edge and the underside of the slab.

risks.risk: The upholstery may be PU/faux leather which peels over time, rather than genuine leather.
risks.proof: A close-up of the material grain and a shot of the underside of a chair seat showing the fabric backing.

risks.risk: The metal frame may be chrome-plated steel which can rust in Lagos's humid environment, rather than stainless steel.
risks.proof: A video of a magnet being applied to the frame (stainless is usually non-magnetic) or a close-up of joints.

risks.risk: The photo may be a stock image and not represent the actual condition of the item for sale.

A close-up photo of the table top edge to verify material thickness and type.

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a 6-seater dining set. While the materials (marble, leather, stainless) are unverified and the photo appears to be a catalog shot, it can be priced at the worst-case value for a generic set of this style (faux marble, PU leather, and chrome-plated steel).
